en.LD_BoardGameScene_Line_0: Donnie wants to play a board game. Here are all the things they need. Help them find these objects.
en.LD_BoardGameScene_Line_1: Well done! you have helped Donnie and Sarah find the items. Now they can play board game in the living room.
en.LD_BookTabletScene_Line_0: Donnie and Sarah is getting bored. Sarah still cannot enter the room. Use the mirrors and help them find a book and a tablet.
en.LD_BookTabletScene_Line_1: Fantastic! You have master how mirrors interact with light. Let's go to the next room.
en.LD_ControlTutorial_Line_0: You can rotate Sarah by clicking in a direction. Try rotating your character towards the circle.
en.LD_ControlTutorial_Line_1: Nice work! now you can rotate your character.
en.LD_ControlTutorial_Line_2: You can move Sarah by double clicking a position. Try moving to the circle area.
en.LD_ControlTutorial_Line_3: Nice work! now you can move your character.
en.LD_CookieMilkScene_Line_0: Oh no! Donnie and Sarah are seperated. Because they are different room, we cannot just walk over to the object and shine it directly.
en.LD_CookieMilkScene_Line_1: Don't worry though. There's a window. Try shining light on one of them.
en.LD_CookieMilkScene_Line_2: As you can see. The light pass through the window and shine the room on the other side. This means the light waves are passing through the object. Objects that have these properties are called transparent object.
en.LD_CookieMilkScene_Line_3: Help Sarah and Donnie find milk, bowl, and cookie.
en.LD_CookieMilkScene_Line_4: Well done! you have finished the level. Donnie and Sarah now can enjoy their meal.
en.LD_HandFanHatScene_Line_0: This room is really dark. It seems that there's no light that can reach it. This makes it really difficult to shine the object from the mirror.
en.LD_HandFanHatScene_Line_1: No need to stress, We have a window right next to it. Let's use the window.
en.LD_HandFanHatScene_Line_2: Unfortunately, this window has a curtain on the other side.
en.LD_HandFanHatScene_Line_3: The curtains allow some light to pass through but it's not clearly visible. This is because the curtain scatter the light causing the vision to be blurry and poorly lit. Objects that have these properties are called translucent object.
en.LD_HandFanHatScene_Line_4: Donnie still cannot see the object when we shine the light through translucent object. But perhaps this helps Sarah to know where the object is before shining the light from the mirror.
en.LD_HandFanHatScene_Line_5: Help Donnie and Sarah find the hat and hand fan.
en.LD_HandFanHatScene_Line_6: Nicely done! You've clearly grasped the concept of translucent objects.
en.LD_LightOutHints_Answer_0: You can rotate by clicking in a direction. After clicking in a direction the character will then rotate towards your pointer location.
en.LD_LightOutHints_Answer_1: You can move by double clicking in a location. After double clicking the character will then move to your pointer location.
en.LD_LightOutHints_Answer_2: Light can interact with objects in different ways. When light hits an object, the light rays will bounce towards our eyes allowing us to see the object.
en.LD_LightOutHints_Answer_3: A shadow is a dark area that is caused by a light source getting blocked by another object.
en.LD_LightOutScene_Line_0: Meet Sarah and Donnie. Brother and sister enjoying winter night.
en.LD_LightOutScene_Line_1: Oh no! The electricity is out....
en.LD_LightOutScene_Line_2: With no light, both of them cannot see.
en.LD_LightOutScene_Line_4: Light is a form of energy that helps use see objects. Light can be produced from two type of sources, they are artificial light source and natural light source. Flashlight is one of artificial light source.
en.LD_LightOutScene_Line_5: Now they can see the TV.
en.LD_LightOutScene_Line_6: Light can interact with objects in different ways. In this case, when light rays hits the small desk it bounces to our eyes allowing us too see the small desk.
en.LD_LightOutScene_Line_7: The area that is behind the small desk is still dark because it doesn't get hit by the light ray. These are called a shadow.
en.LD_LightOutScene_Line_8: Now let's play a game! So I'll tell you the object's name that you need to shine the light on. When you're ready click the Magnifying glass button on bottom left.
en.LD_LightOutScene_Line_9: If you shine the right object, Donnie will go to the object's position. Don't worry, Donnie will tell you if you shine the wrong object as well.
en.LD_LightOutScene_Line_10: You're a natural. Now you can rotate and move your character and understand how to shine light on objects.
en.LD_LightOutScene_Line_11: Let's continue to the next level!
en.LD_MelodicaFluteDrumKitScene_Line_0: This is it – the final test! You'll need to apply everything you've learned to help Donnie and Sarah find the melodica, flute, and drum kit. Good luck!
en.LD_MelodicaFluteDrumKitScene_Line_1: Spectacular! Your understanding of how light interacts with objects is complete.
en.LD_Mirror_Hints_Answer_0: Mirror is a reflective surface that bounces light the same angle as the light hits the mirror.
en.LD_Mirror_Hints_Answer_1: Translucent object is an object that allows some light to passthrough while scattering the light ray. Some examples are curtains and plastics.
en.LD_PillowBlanketScene_Line_0: Let's make it more interesting. Sarah cannot cross the boundary to enter the room. Don't worry Sarah should still be able to help Donnie find the dolls.
en.LD_PillowBlanketScene_Line_1: Try shining on one of the mirror.
en.LD_PillowBlanketScene_Line_2: Notice that when the light from the flashlight hits the mirror, the light is reflected. This is because the surface of the mirror is smooth allowing light to bounce back at the same angle. Objects that have these properties are called mirrors.
en.LD_PillowBlanketScene_Line_3: You can use these mirror to help Donnie find two small dolls and a big doll.
en.LD_PillowBlanketScene_Line_4: Awesome work! Now you understand how light interacts with a reflective surface. Let's continue.
en.LD_StaticUI_Line_ChoiceDialogueAsk: What can I help you with?
en.LD_TentCarpetScene_Line_0: This time one of the window is covered with window blind. The window blind, blocks the light coming in from the window.
en.LD_TentCarpetScene_Line_1: You can draw open or close the window blind by switching the lever. Try it out!
en.LD_TentCarpetScene_Line_2: Well done. Now help Donnie and Sarah find two batteries and a candle pack.
en.LD_TentCarpetScene_Line_3: Nice work! now donnie have two extra spare batteries if the flashlight's battery ever run out.
en.LD_TransparentHints_Answer_0: Transparent objects are objects that allow lights to pass through. Some examples are glass, clear plastic, etc.
en.LD_TransparentHints_Ask_1: How to draw open or close the blind?
en.LD_TransparentHints_Answer_1: You can draw the window blind open or closed by shining light on the lever and press the magnify button icon.
